item.title: RESOLVED: Users will be unable to provision new resources
item.description:

item.title: IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service is affected by Kubernetes Ingress Controller security vulnerabilities (CVE-2025-24514, CVE-2025-1097, CVE-2025-1098)
item.description:
IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service is affected by Kubernetes Ingress Controller security vulnerabilities where a user that can create or update Ingress objects can use the nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-url annotation (CVE-2025-24514) or the nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-match-cn annotation (CVE-2025-1097) or nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/mirror-target and nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/mirror-host annotations (CVE-2025-1098) to inject arbitrary configuration to obtain the credentials of the Kubernetes Ingress Controller (ALB). In the default configuration, that credential has access to all secrets in the cluster.


These vulnerabilities are relevant mainly in multi-tenant environments where non-admin users have permissions to create Ingress objects.


To understand the actions required to ensure your ALBs are no longer exposed to these vulnerabilities, see the security bulletin.

item.title: IBM Cloud: End of Support & End of Marketing Notices – December 2025
item.description:
Please be aware that IBM Cloud is announcing end of support (EOS) and end of marketing (EOM) for the following services on the dates listed below:

 

End of Support

  • Windows Server 2016 on IBM Classic and VPC effective: 12 January 2027. Details: Classic, VPC
  • FortiGate Security Appliance 10Gbps Hardware Firewall. IBM Shared Hardware Firewall. Effective: 31 December 2026. Details: Alternative Firewalls

 

End of Marketing

  • Windows Server 2016 on IBM Classic and VPC effective: 12 February 2026. Details: Classic, VPC
  • FortiGate Security Appliance 10Gbps Hardware Firewall. IBM Shared Hardware Firewall. Effective: 17 December 2025. Details: Alternative Firewalls

 

 

If you have any further questions about these changes, please contact your IBM or IBM Business Partner representative, or IBM Cloud Support.

 

Thank you for being a valued IBM Cloud Customer

item.title: Notice of change to IAM Account Settings audit events
item.description:
Effective 10th January 2026, the content of audit event iam-identity.accountsettings.update will change. 

 

Current Event Content

Currently, the audit event contains both 'new_<account-settings-property>' and 'old_<account-settings-property>' of all existing account settings.

 

What is changing? 

From 10th January 2026, the event will contain both 'new_<account-settings-property>' and 'old_<account-settings-property>'  only of properties that have been modified. 

 

Customers are advised to update any processing of these events to anticipate these changes.
